_meta.title: 1 Timothy — key verses per chapter (King James Version, public domain)
_meta.description: Several curated key verses from each of the 6 chapters of 1 Timothy. Ecosystem-generic 864zeros content. Each record carries the exact scripture plus an original plain-English rendering.
_meta.license: Public domain (KJV scripture); 'plain' renderings are original 864zeros writing
_meta.source: getbible.net v2 (KJV, book 54 1 Timothy); verses verbatim, curly apostrophes normalized to straight
_meta.selection: several key verses per chapter (~1-4, scaled to chapter substance)
_meta.keying: book + chapter + citation; multiple records per chapter
_meta.renderings: text = the exact KJV verse; plain = original 864zeros plain-English 2026 rendering, faithful to the verse's meaning (~grade 6-8), authored not quoted.

verses.text: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.
verses.plain: Here is a trustworthy saying that deserves full acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners — of whom I am the worst.

verses.text: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;
verses.plain: First of all, then, I urge that petitions, prayers, intercession, and thanksgiving be made for everyone,

verses.text: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
verses.plain: For there is one God and one mediator between God and mankind, the man Christ Jesus,

verses.text: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.
verses.plain: Beyond all question, the mystery from which true godliness springs is great: He appeared in the flesh, was vindicated by the Spirit, was seen by angels, was preached among the nations, was believed on in the world, was taken up in glory.

verses.text: For bodily exercise profiteth little: but godliness is profitable unto all things, having promise of the life that now is, and of that which is to come.
verses.plain: Physical training is of some value, but godliness has value for everything, holding promise for both the present life and the life to come.

verses.text: Let no man despise thy youth; but be thou an example of the believers, in word, in conversation, in charity, in spirit, in faith, in purity.
verses.plain: Don't let anyone look down on you because you are young, but set an example for the believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith, and in purity.

verses.text: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.
verses.plain: Anyone who does not provide for their own, and especially their own household, has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.

verses.text: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
verses.plain: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

verses.text: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.
verses.plain: For the love of money is the root of all kinds of evil. Some, eager for it, have wandered from the faith and pierced themselves with many griefs.

verses.text: But thou, O man of God, flee these things; and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, meekness.
verses.plain: But you, person of God, flee from all this, and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, endurance, and gentleness.

verses.text: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.
verses.plain: Fight the good fight of the faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called when you made your good confession before many witnesses.
